ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lop'ānubandh'ariyam'attha-vibhāga-tīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.

30082.commentary: (VVt) taracchā'ti kāḷasīhā. (VINt) tattha sīsagīvātaraṅgena carantā acchavisesāva taracchā (APt) mahākukkurappamāṇo kukkurākati kaṇhalekhācittasarīro gomanuss'ādihiṃsakkhamo rassamukho taraccho nāma, so sunakhabyaggho'ti vuccati.

examples.text: sārambhaṃ nāma… dīpīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, acchānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, taracchānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, yesaṃ kesañci tiracchānagatānaṃ pāṇānaṃ āsayo hoti, pubb'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, apar'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti
catuppadānan'ti sīhā byagghā dīpi acchā taracchā kokā mahiṃsā hatthī.

30083.meaning1: remains of a hyena kill; hyena's leftovers

30084.commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.8) aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāyā'ti ṭhapetvā tiriyaṃ taraṇaṃ but (VINa) tiriyaṃ taraṇāyā'ti upayogatthe nissakkavacanaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhiruheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya, pācittiyaṃ.

buddho so bhagavā bodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, danto so bhagavā damathāya dhammaṃ deseti, santo so bhagavā samathāya dhammaṃ deseti, tiṇṇo so bhagavā taraṇāya dhammaṃ deseti, parinibbuto so bhagavā parinibbānāya dhammaṃ desetī'ti

30087.commentary: (SNa) tareyyā'ti ettha tebhūmakavaṭṭaṃ samatikkamanto nibbānaṃ paṭivijjhanto taratī'ti paṭivedhataraṇaṃ nāma vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ nattam'ah'ābhipassa.
eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.

30088.commentary: (THa) yo dandhakāle taratī'ti kismiñci kattabbavatthusmiṃ, kappati nu kho, na nu kho kappatī'ti vinayakukkucce uppanne yāva viyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ pucchitvā taṃ kukkuccaṃ na vinodeti, tāva dandhakāle tassa kiccassa dandhāyitabbasamaye tarati madditvā vītikkamaṃ karoti.

examples.text: yo dandhakāle tarati, taraṇīye ca dandhaye, ayoni saṃvidhānena, bālo dukkhaṃ nigacchati.

30089.meaning1: cross over this! go through this!

examples.text: yāya devā manussā ca, sitā tiṭṭhanti atthikā, tarath'etaṃ visattikaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo andhakavindā rājagahaṃ uposathaṃ āgacchanto antarāmagge nadiṃ taranto manaṃ vūḷho ahosi, cīvarāni'ssa allāni.
gunnaṃ ce taramānānaṃ, jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo, sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti, nette jimhaṃ gate sati.
ataramāno'va bhāseyya no taramāno'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
tatra, bhikkhave, taramānassa bhāsato kāyo'pi kilamati, cittam'pi upahaññati, saro'pi upahaññati, kaṇṭho'pi āturīyati, avisaṭṭham'pi hoti aviññeyyaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ.

30093.meaning1: in a great hurry; hurrying quickly; hurriedly

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo taramānarūpo jetavanā nikkhamitvā sāvatthiṃ pavisitvā addasa bhagavantaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ
atha kho rāhu asur'indo candimaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena vepacitti asur'indo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

30094.meaning1: hurries past; flies by; races past quickly
30094.commentary: (SNa) tarayanti rattiyo'ti rattiyo atikkamamānā puggalaṃ maraṇ'ūpagamanāya tarayanti sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gamayanti.

examples.text: accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.
ek'āyanaṃ jātikhay'antadassī, maggaṃ pajānāti hit'ānukampī, etena maggena tariṃsu pubbe, tarissanti ye ca taranti oghan'ti.

30099.meaning1: should be hurried; should be rushed (to)
30099.commentary: (MNa) na codanāya taritabban'ti na codan'atthāya vegāyitabbaṃ. ekacco hi puggalo nalāṭe te sāsapamattā piḷakā'ti vutto mayhaṃ nalāṭe sāsapamattaṃ piḷakaṃ passasi, attano nalāṭe tālapakkamattaṃ mahāgaṇḍaṃ na passasī'ti vadati. tasmā puggalo upaparikkhitabbo.

examples.text: tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ siyā aññatarassa bhikkhuno āpatti siyā vītikkamo, tatra, bhikkhave, na codanāya taritabbaṃ.
